title: 第3章 狗就是狗永远都不可能成为人第4章 你做初一我便能做十五
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 砰！
一声巨响，原本厚重的木门，被一脚狠狠地踹开。
从外面走进来数十人，一个个凶神恶煞，明显看上去是来找茬的。
“少爷，苏辰还未醒来，我们如此闯进来，会不会被家主怪罪。”
啪！
青年狠狠地甩出一个耳光，阴沉的脸上透漏著一丝丝凶狠，冷冷道：“真是废物，苏辰即將被逐出家族，我还需要在乎吗？苏辰明显是不想接受现实，才故意装昏死，这点小把戏，休想骗到我。”
苏阳，苏家大爷苏玄的儿子，三天前繁衍出血轮，並且顺利筑基，成为苏家年轻一辈之中，第二个筑基成功的人。
第一个筑基的人是苏辰。
哪怕是当年苏辰的帝骨被剥离，天赋和实力依然要傲视整个苏家。
苏阳犹如一条哈巴狗，天天跟在苏辰后面，哥长哥短，要多卑微有多卑微。
也正是因为如此，看著苏辰血轮被废，修为跌落到先天境，苏阳心里简直爽到天，实力的调转，使得他们的身份也会跟著一起转变。
他不要再是曾经那个只会点头哈腰的哈巴狗，如今的他完全可以俯视苏辰，將曾经失去的尊严全部拿回来。
在苏阳看来，不管苏辰昏迷是真是假，他都会在苏辰被逐出家族之前，好好地羞辱一番。
“给我进去把苏辰拖出来，我倒要看看，他能装到什么时候。”
没有人敢违背。
如今的苏家，情况明显已经不同。
曾经那个意气风发的苏辰，隨著血轮碎裂，外加苏族的威慑，地位不仅一落千丈，更是会被家主逐出家族。
苏辰风光时，苏阳绝对是最阿諛奉承的人，只是现在，曾经的跪舔却变成了狠毒，唯有如此，才能够抚平心中的愤怒和尊严。
反观苏阳，已经顺利筑基，稍后更是会前往苏族，到时候不要说他们，就算是家主见了，都要毕恭毕敬。
不等眾人进房。
咯吱。
房门被推开，苏辰从里面走了出来。
看著面前数十人，脸色很是森冷，声音透漏出丝丝寒意，冷冷道：“所有人全部滚出去。”
血轮被废，修为跌落到先天境，还敢在这里装逼？
苏阳冷哼一声，满脸嘲讽道：“苏辰，你休要猖狂，爷爷已经决定將你逐出家族，现在的你，只是一条无家可归的狗，你要是跪在我面前求我，也许我会善待你，否则的话，后果你自己体会。”
一脸的小人得志。
越是如此，苏阳心里越是感到爽歪歪，他就是要將苏辰踩在脚下，狠狠地羞辱。
羞辱这个曾经的苏家天才。
只要想到当初的自己，跟在此人屁股后面做狗，苏阳就忍不住心里的怒火，羞辱才能让他感到挽回尊严，才能够让他爽。
站在苏阳背后的数十人，一个个摩拳擦掌，眼神狠毒地看著面前苏辰。
能够羞辱曾经的家族天才，对於他们来说，绝对是非常爽的事情。
他们现在要做的事情，就是討好苏阳，才能够获得最大利益和好处。
踩苏辰，才能够得到苏阳的青睞。
“苏阳，以前你是狗，现在的你依然是狗，至於你想叫两声，也要看看你的獠牙够不够锋利。”
被当眾骂狗。
content_en:
Bang!
There was a loud noise, and the originally heavy wooden door was kicked open hard.
Dozens of people walked in from outside, each with a fierce look, and they obviously looked like they were looking for trouble.
"Master, Su Chen hasn't woken up yet. If we break in like this, will the family master blame us?"
Snap!
The young man slapped her hard, with a hint of ferocity on his gloomy face, and said coldly: "What a waste. Su Chen is about to be expelled from the family. Do I still need to care? Su Chen obviously doesn't want to accept the reality, so he deliberately pretends to be dead. You can't fool me with this little trick."
Su Yang, the son of Su Xuan, the eldest son of the Su family, reproduced the blood wheel three days ago and successfully established the foundation. He became the second person among the younger generation of the Su family to successfully establish the foundation.
The first person to build the foundation was Su Chen.
Even if Su Chen's imperial bones were stripped off back then, his talent and strength would still dwarf the entire Su family.
Su Yang was like a pug, following Su Chen every day. He was older and younger, and he was as humble as he wanted.
It is precisely because of this that Su Yang felt so happy when he saw Su Chen's blood wheel was abolished and his cultivation level dropped to the innate realm. The change in strength caused their identities to change together.
He is no longer the pug that only nodded and bowed. Now he can look down at Su Chen and regain all the dignity he once lost.
From Su Yang's point of view, regardless of whether Su Chen's coma was true or not, he would humiliate Su Chen before being expelled from the family.
"Go in and drag Su Chen out for me. I want to see how long he can keep pretending."
"Yes."
No one dares to violate it.
Today's situation in the Su family is obviously different.
The once high-spirited Su Chen, with the shattering of his blood wheel and the intimidation of the Su clan, not only has his status plummeted, but he will also be expelled from the family by the head of the family.
When Su Chen was in glory, Su Yang was definitely the most flattering person, but now, the former kneeling and licking has turned into viciousness. Only in this way can the anger and dignity in his heart be healed.
On the other hand, Su Yang has successfully established the foundation, and will go to the Su clan later. Don't talk about them then, even if you meet the head of the family, you must be respectful.
Don't wait for everyone to enter the room.
Creak.
The door was pushed open and Su Chen walked out.
Looking at the dozens of people in front of him, his face was very cold, his voice revealed a hint of chill, and he said coldly: "Everyone, get out."
The blood wheel has been abolished, and the cultivation has fallen to the innate realm. How dare you show off here?
Su Yang snorted coldly and said with a face full of ridicule: "Su Chen, don't be so arrogant. Grandpa has decided to expel you from the family. Now you are just a homeless dog. If you kneel in front of me and beg me, maybe I will treat you kindly. Otherwise, you will experience the consequences yourself."
He looks like a villain with a triumphant look.
The more this happened, the happier Su Yang felt in his heart. He just wanted to trample Su Chen under his feet and humiliate him severely.
Humiliate this former genius of the Su family.
As long as he thought of himself, following this person's back as a dog, Su Yang couldn't help but feel angry in his heart. Only humiliation could make him feel that he could regain his dignity and feel good.
Dozens of people standing behind Su Yang were all gearing up and looking at Su Chen in front of them with vicious eyes.
Being able to humiliate the former family genius is definitely a very satisfying thing for them.
What they have to do now is to please Su Yang so that they can obtain the maximum benefits and benefits.
Only by stepping on Su Chen can he gain Su Yang's favor.
"Su Yang, you were a dog before, but you are still a dog now. As for whether you want to bark twice, you have to see if your fangs are sharp enough."
Being called a dog in public.
title_en: Chapter 3 A dog is a dog and can never become a human. Chapter 4 If you are in the first grade of junior high school, I will be in the fifteenth grade.
